finding.statement: Candidate C, the Berkhamsted John Gurney, is eliminated on three independent grounds. Henry's 1610 baptism puts the father's own birth no later than about 1585-1590, thirteen to eighteen years before the colonial John's c.1603. Three of the eight Berkhamsted children - Henry, Michael, and Francis - have no counterpart in the colonial family, and the colonial John's Mary and Peter have no counterpart at Berkhamsted. The three shared names miss on date: Berkhamsted's John Jr. was baptised in 1624 against the colonial John Jr.'s c.1633, Richard in 1626 against c.1630, Sarah in 1634 against c.1628. Any one ground would suffice. Candidate C is the last of the principal named alternatives to be cleared.
